references.text: Psalm 1:1-2 highlights the contrast between the righteous and sinners, reflecting the theme in Mark 2:16 about fellowship with sinners.
Isaiah 65:2 describes God's open arms toward a rebellious people, parallel to Jesus' openness toward sinners in Mark 2:16.
Matthew 9:10-13 tells a similar story of Jesus eating with sinners and tax collectors, emphasizing Jesus' message of mercy.
Luke 5:29-32 gives a parallel account to Mark 2:16, where Jesus explains why he associates with sinners.
John 2:15-16 shows Jesus acting with divine authority, which can be connected to his authoritative actions in Mark 2:16.
